name: The St. Regis Macao, Cotai Central
positioning: The St. Regis Macao, a St. Regis hotel at The Londoner Macao on the Cotai Strip, with design that blends classic motifs and local Macanese inspiration
best_for: Travelers who want a Cotai Strip base close to shopping and entertainment
Guests who value butler service and hands-on food and cocktail experiences

facts.text: The hotel's address is The Londoner Macao, Estrada do Istmo, in Cotai, Macau.
The hotel is on the Cotai Strip, in an entertainment and shopping center with more than 850 luxury stores.
Macau International Airport is about 3 kilometers from the hotel.
The St. Regis Butler service is available to all hotel guests.
Marble bathrooms have a double-basin vanity, a separate shower and soaking bathtub, and a mirror-embedded LCD television.
The Manor, the hotel's signature restaurant, serves Mediterranean dining with artisanal seafood and crafted cocktails.
The St. Regis Bar serves artisan cocktails and chef-crafted menus in a setting inspired by the House of Astor.
The Pavilion offers casual alfresco dining with family-friendly fare beside the outdoor pool.
The outdoor pool is on the eighth floor, with an all-day menu and full beverage service.
The concierge team can coordinate reservations for ferry cruises and helicopter tours.
Guests can join a mixologist at The St. Regis Bar to mix their own Bloody Mary cocktails.
The hotel is a Forbes Travel Guide 2026 Five-Star Hotel.

highlights.text: The hotel's signature cocktail, Maria do Leste, is its take on the Bloody Mary, inspired by the voyages of Portuguese sailors.
A candy workshop features Yau Kei's Dragon's Beard Candy, demonstrated by second-generation master Kenny Yuen.
Rooms and suites are fitted with traditional Chinese elements and have marble bathrooms with products from SACHAJUAN, Sodashi and REN.
The St. Regis Athletic Club is on the eighth floor, with floor-to-ceiling views of the Cotai Strip.
In a small-group cooking class, the hotel's chefs teach guests to make two signature dishes from The Manor.

considerations.text: The hotel does not have an airport shuttle to Macau International Airport.
Children 1.4 meters tall and under must wear arm bands or life vests in the pool area; the hotel provides them free of charge.
WhataHotel notes the busy casino resort environment may not suit all travelers.
